description: Machine readable taxonomy of App Store and Google Play rejection patterns. Drives the pre submission guard. Each pattern carries a platform, the cited guideline or policy, a severity, an automatable detection signal, and the fix.

patterns.title: Font scaling disabled due to dp text sizing
patterns.detection: Hardcoded text sizes specified in dp instead of sp in Android XML layouts or Jetpack Compose files.
patterns.fix: Always define text sizes in sp (scale-independent pixels) rather than dp to allow the system font scaling to work correctly.

patterns.title: Hardcoded colors ignoring high contrast settings
patterns.detection: Hardcoded hex color strings in layout files or hardcoded Color objects in Compose without using theme attributes.
patterns.fix: Reference semantic colors or color resources so the app automatically respects high contrast themes.

patterns.title: Touch target sizes below 48dp
patterns.detection: Clickable items or buttons defined with layout_width, layout_height, or padding that results in touch targets smaller than 48dp.
patterns.fix: Ensure all interactive elements have a minimum touch target area of 48dp x 48dp by using padding, minWidth, and minHeight.

patterns.title: TalkBack support missing or disabled
patterns.detection: Views or graphic components missing contentDescription or setting importantForAccessibility inappropriately.
patterns.fix: Provide meaningful contentDescription values for all informative images and interactive views, and ensure importantForAccessibility is set correctly.

patterns.title: Account creation without in app deletion and a data deletion URL
patterns.detection: Account creation present but no in app delete path and no web data deletion URL.
patterns.fix: Provide in app account deletion and set a public data deletion URL in the Play Console listing.

patterns.title: Google Play Advertising ID usage without disclosure or opt-out
patterns.detection: Using com.google.android.gms.permission.AD_ID permission or querying GAID but lacking opt-out support or user deletion pathways in code/privacy policy.
patterns.fix: Declare the AD_ID permission in AndroidManifest.xml and handle user opt-out or deletion requests in full compliance with Google Play policy.

patterns.title: Dynamic code loading at runtime
patterns.detection: DexClassLoader, PathClassLoader from a downloaded file, or downloading and executing code at runtime.
patterns.fix: Ship all code in the package. Server side changes must be data, not executable code.

patterns.title: Health or fitness data access without Health Connect declaration
patterns.detection: Accessing Health Connect client or querying health permissions (e.g. steps, heart rate) without proper declaration or dedicated health privacy policy.
patterns.fix: Declare Health Connect permissions, complete the console Health Connect form, and maintain a dedicated health privacy policy.

patterns.title: Android backup is enabled without filtering sensitive data
patterns.detection: android:allowBackup is set to true in AndroidManifest.xml without setting data extraction rules to exclude credentials/databases.
patterns.fix: Disable backups with allowBackup="false", or configure dataExtractionRules / fullBackupContent to exclude sensitive credentials and SQLite databases.

patterns.title: System overlay permission, a tapjacking and malware signal
patterns.detection: SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW or application overlay declared, especially combined with AccessibilityService.
patterns.fix: Remove overlay abuse. The overlay plus accessibility combination is a strong malware signal Google enforces against.

patterns.title: QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES without a permitted use case
patterns.detection: QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES declared in AndroidManifest.
patterns.fix: Declare specific packages with a queries element, or qualify for a permitted use case.

patterns.title: Sensitive runtime permissions requested without validation
patterns.detection: Requesting critical permissions (camera, contacts, storage) without dynamic checks or explicit explanation/rationale to the user.
patterns.fix: Check permissions dynamically at runtime, show a clear rationale if denied, and handle denials gracefully.

patterns.title: Missing prominent disclosure for sensitive user data
patterns.detection: Collecting personal user data (e.g. contacts, SMS, device accounts, files) without a prominent disclosure and explicit user consent block.
patterns.fix: Provide a prominent in-app disclosure before collecting sensitive personal data, and obtain explicit user consent.

patterns.title: User generated content without the 24 hour action mechanism
patterns.detection: UGC present without a EULA with zero tolerance for objectionable content, content filtering, a flag mechanism, user blocking, and the ability to act on a report within 24 hours by removing content and ejecting the user.
patterns.fix: Add a zero tolerance EULA, content filtering, in app reporting, user blocking, and a process to act on reports within 24 hours. Source. real Apple Safety 1.2 rejection email.

patterns.title: iCloud or CloudKit schema not deployed to production
patterns.detection: The app uses CloudKit or iCloud but the schema and containers are only in the development environment, so the feature fails for the reviewer on the production build.
patterns.fix: Deploy the CloudKit schema and containers to production before submitting. Source. lukylab checklist.

patterns.title: Debug or test features shipped in the production build
patterns.detection: Debug menus, test logins, or developer backdoors left visible in the release build rather than gated behind a debug only flag.
patterns.fix: Hide debug and test features behind a debug only compile flag so they never ship in production. Source. lukylab checklist.

patterns.title: Account based app without demo credentials
patterns.detection: Login or auth code present (SignInWithApple, OAuth, Auth, login view) but no demo account note found in review metadata or fastlane review_information.
patterns.fix: Add a working demo account and a live test path to the Notes for Review field before submission.

patterns.title: Placeholder content in the build
patterns.detection: Strings such as lorem ipsum, TODO, FIXME, placeholder, dummy, test data, example.com found in shipped resources.
patterns.fix: Replace all placeholder text and assets with real content before submission.

patterns.title: Review notes missing a required section for a new submission
patterns.detection: New submission review notes omit one of the six sections. Screen recording on a physical device, app purpose, access instructions and test credentials, external services list, regional differences, and regulated industry documentation.
patterns.fix: Fill all six review notes sections using templates/REVIEW-NOTES-TEMPLATE.md. Source. truongduy2611 review_notes rules.

patterns.title: Backend points at staging or localhost
patterns.detection: API base URL in the release config contains localhost, 127.0.0.1, staging, dev, or ngrok.
patterns.fix: Point the release build at the live production backend and confirm it stays up during review.

patterns.title: New 2026 age rating questionnaire not answered
patterns.detection: Manual check. The updated age rating questions (13 plus, 16 plus, 18 plus) must be answered by 31 January 2026 to submit updates.
patterns.fix: Answer the updated age rating questionnaire in App Store Connect for every app.

patterns.title: Reference to other platform or marketplace
patterns.detection: Strings such as Android, Google Play, or alternative marketplace names found in app facing copy or metadata.
patterns.fix: Remove references to other platforms and marketplaces from the app and metadata.

patterns.title: Metadata promises features that do not ship in this build
patterns.detection: Listing or in app copy uses coming soon, beta, or a promised feature not present in the build. Mirrors the fastlane precheck future_functionality rule.
patterns.fix: Describe only what the build does today. Remove coming soon and future feature promises from the listing.

patterns.title: Metadata names an iOS bug or references Apple negatively
patterns.detection: Listing copy mentions an iOS bug or makes a negative or insensitive reference to Apple. Mirrors the fastlane precheck negative_apple_sentiment rule.
patterns.fix: Remove negative references to Apple and iOS bugs from the listing copy.

patterns.title: Device frames around the app in a preview video
patterns.detection: Manual metadata check. The app preview video wraps the app in a device frame instead of showing the app full screen.
patterns.fix: Capture the preview video full screen from the device, without a device frame overlay.

patterns.title: Entitlements declared but not used
patterns.detection: An entitlements file declares a capability the app does not use. Apple requests justification for any entitlement with no matching functionality, which blocks review. Temporary exception entitlements draw extra scrutiny.
patterns.fix: Remove any entitlement the app does not actively use. Cross check each entitlement against real code usage. Source. truongduy2611 unused_entitlements rule.

patterns.title: Private API or deprecated framework use
patterns.detection: References to known private API selectors or deprecated frameworks found in the binary or code.
patterns.fix: Use only documented public APIs and current frameworks.

patterns.title: Digital goods sold outside in app purchase
patterns.detection: A web checkout or external payment SDK is used for digital content rather than StoreKit.
patterns.fix: Route all digital goods through StoreKit in app purchase unless the app is a documented exempt category.

patterns.title: Subscription shows the per month price more prominently than the billed amount
patterns.detection: Manual paywall check. An annual subscription shows a small per month figure large and the actual billed total small.
patterns.fix: Show the actual amount the user will be charged at least as prominently as any per month figure. Source. truongduy2611 misleading_pricing rule.

patterns.title: Sign in with Apple UX violation
patterns.detection: Asking for name or email again after Sign in with Apple already provided them, a non standard SIWA button, hiding SIWA below other social logins, or rejecting a private relay email.
patterns.fix: Use the name and email from the Apple credential, do not re ask, use the standard SIWA button, keep SIWA at least as prominent as other logins, and accept private relay emails. Source. truongduy2611 sign_in_with_apple rule.

patterns.title: Thin web wrapper with no added value
patterns.detection: The app is mostly a single web view loading a website with little native code.
patterns.fix: Add native capability, offline value, device integration, or content the web version lacks.

patterns.title: Third party social login without an equal alternative
patterns.detection: Facebook, Google, or similar social login is present without Sign in with Apple or an equal privacy preserving option.
patterns.fix: Add Sign in with Apple or an equal login that limits data to name and email and allows a private email.

patterns.title: Missing privacy policy
patterns.detection: No privacy policy URL in App Store Connect metadata and no in app privacy link reference in the codebase.
patterns.fix: Publish a privacy policy, link it in App Store Connect, and reach it from inside the app.

patterns.title: Sensitive framework linked without a usage description
patterns.detection: A sensitive framework or API is referenced in code but the matching NSxUsageDescription key is absent from Info.plist.
patterns.fix: Add the matching usage description key with a specific reason for every sensitive framework used.

patterns.title: Account creation without in app account deletion
patterns.detection: Account creation or sign up code present but no delete account flow found.
patterns.fix: Add an in app account deletion flow for any app that supports account creation.

patterns.title: Requiring personal data not relevant to core functionality
patterns.detection: A registration or onboarding form requires phone number, gender, marital status, date of birth, or home address when it is not essential to the core feature. Relevance is contextual.
patterns.fix: Make non essential personal fields optional. Require only data directly relevant to the core feature. Source. truongduy2611 unnecessary_data rule.

patterns.title: Generic or empty permission purpose string
patterns.detection: An NSxUsageDescription key in Info.plist is empty or carries a generic value such as needs access or required.
patterns.fix: Write a specific purpose string naming the real feature that uses each permission.

patterns.title: Personal data shared with third party AI without consent modal
patterns.detection: A third party AI or LLM SDK is present and personal data may be sent without a consent modal naming the provider.
patterns.fix: Show a consent modal naming the AI provider and data types before any personal data leaves the app.

patterns.title: Tracking SDK without App Tracking Transparency
patterns.detection: A tracking or advertising SDK is present but ATTrackingManager request is not called and NSUserTrackingUsageDescription is absent.
patterns.fix: Call the ATT prompt before any cross app tracking and add the tracking usage description.

patterns.title: Apple device image or Apple trademark in the icon or screenshots
patterns.detection: Manual metadata check. The app icon or screenshots show an Apple device, the Apple logo, or imply Apple endorsement.
patterns.fix: Remove Apple device images and Apple marks from the icon and screenshots. Source. truongduy2611 apple_trademark rule.

patterns.title: Color Contrast and system settings ignored
patterns.detection: Hardcoded custom colors used without supporting dark/light mode, high-contrast settings, or checking isDarkerSystemColorsEnabled.
patterns.fix: Use dynamic or system colors that automatically adapt, or monitor isDarkerSystemColorsEnabled to adjust contrast dynamically.

patterns.title: Dynamic Type support missing or overridden
patterns.detection: Hardcoded font sizes or styles used without matching scaling or preferredFont APIs, or adjustsFontForContentSizeCategory set to false.
patterns.fix: Use preferredFont(forTextStyle:) in UIKit and system/relative font styles in SwiftUI, ensuring adjustsFontForContentSizeCategory is enabled.

patterns.title: Haptics tactile feedback missing on interactions
patterns.detection: Interactive elements, buttons, or custom controls lacking feedback generators or CoreHaptics calls.
patterns.fix: Add haptic feedback to buttons, toggles, and swipe actions using UIImpactFeedbackGenerator or selection feedback.

patterns.title: Keyboard navigation and focus state support missing
patterns.detection: Custom text editors or complex navigation flows missing keyCommands, focusState, or focusable modifiers.
patterns.fix: Support physical keyboard navigation by utilizing keyCommands in UIKit or focusable() and @FocusState in SwiftUI.

patterns.title: Reduce Motion accessibility setting ignored
patterns.detection: Custom animations or transitions without checks for UIAccessibility.isReduceMotionEnabled or environment accessibilityReduceMotion.
patterns.fix: Check the Reduce Motion system status and disable or simplify non-essential animations when requested by the user.

patterns.title: VoiceOver support missing or incomplete
patterns.detection: Interactive views or images without accessibilityLabel, accessibilityIdentifier, isAccessibilityElement, or accessibilityElement(children:) properties.
patterns.fix: Ensure all interactive components and decorative or informative images have correct accessibility labels, hints, and traits assigned.

patterns.title: Account deletion is a mailto or deactivate only flow
patterns.detection: The only account removal path is a mailto link, a web form the user must leave the app to reach, or a deactivate that does not delete.
patterns.fix: Provide genuine in app deletion of the account and its data, not a deactivate or an external form.

patterns.title: Missing encryption declaration leaves the build in Missing Compliance
patterns.detection: ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption is not set in Info.plist, so each submission stalls in Missing Compliance and never reaches review.
patterns.fix: Set ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption in Info.plist. The exempt answer applies to a standard HTTPS only app.

patterns.title: Missing Brazilian fixed-odds betting license
patterns.detection: An app that indicates gambling/betting features but does not provide a valid fixed-odds betting license from the Secretariat of Prizes and Bets (SPA) in its App Review Information section when distributing on the Brazil storefront.
patterns.fix: Select 'Yes' to the gambling question in the age rating questionnaire (which automatically sets the Brazil age rating to A18), provide a valid fixed-odds betting license from the Secretariat of Prizes and Bets (SPA) in the App Review Information field, and submit a new app version for verification.

patterns.title: Required reason APIs or third party SDKs without a privacy manifest
patterns.detection: Required reason API usage or a commonly used third party SDK is present but no PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy is bundled, or an SDK lacks its signed manifest. Enforced by Apple at upload since 2024. The top modern Apple upload rejection.
patterns.fix: Add a PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy with NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes and approved reason codes, list NSPrivacyTrackingDomains, and confirm every third party SDK ships its signed manifest.

patterns.title: Missing Privacy Nutrition Labels data type declarations
patterns.detection: Collecting sensitive user data (e.g. email, phone, name, coordinates) but missing the privacyNutritionLabels declaration or proper nutrition disclosure references.
patterns.fix: Update the app privacy manifest (PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy) with NSPrivacyCollectedDataTypes and complete corresponding Nutrition Labels in App Store Connect.

patterns.title: Non consumable purchase without a Restore Purchases control
patterns.detection: StoreKit purchases are present but no restore path is found.
patterns.fix: Add a visible Restore Purchases control. It is required for non consumables and non renewing subscriptions.

patterns.title: Generative AI output without moderation or safeguards
patterns.detection: A generative AI or image generation integration is present without content filtering, reporting, blocking, age rating, or abuse safeguards. Apple applies UGC rules to AI output. Google has a dedicated AI Generated Content policy.
patterns.fix: Add moderation, reporting, blocking, an accurate age rating, and abuse safeguards. Prevent NSFW, deepfake, face swap, and undress generation.

patterns.title: Missing legal representative or emergency data-production response procedures for the EU e-Evidence Package
patterns.detection: Apps/services processing user data in the EU that fail to designate a legal representative or lack internal procedures to respond to European Production/Preservation Orders within 10 days (or 8 hours for emergencies).
patterns.fix: Designate an establishment or appoint a legal representative in the EU, notify contact details by August 18, 2026, and establish internal protocols to deliver user data securely within 8 hours in emergency situations.

patterns.guideline: Apple 5.1.2, Google Device and Network Abuse
patterns.title: Device fingerprinting to track users
patterns.detection: Building a persistent device fingerprint from hardware or settings to identify users. Apple bans this regardless of ATT consent.
patterns.fix: Do not fingerprint. Use the platform advertising identifier with consent where tracking is genuinely needed.

patterns.title: Missing EU GPSR manufacturer info or product safety warning disclosures
patterns.detection: E-commerce or digital product listing present but missing manufacturer email, postal address, or product safety warnings on the interface.
patterns.fix: Provide prominent manufacturer contact details (email and postal address) and any applicable product safety warnings directly on the product listing or online interface for any consumer goods distributed in the EU.

patterns.title: Random reward mechanic without disclosed odds
patterns.detection: Loot box, gacha, or random reward purchase present without odds disclosed before purchase.
patterns.fix: Disclose the odds for every random reward before the user purchases.

patterns.title: Metadata field overflow or banned decoration
patterns.detection: App name over the limit (Apple 30, Google 30), emoji in the title, all caps, or ranking and price claims such as number one, best, top, or free in the title or icon.
patterns.fix: Keep each metadata field within its limit and remove emoji, all caps, and ranking or price claims from the title and icon.

patterns.title: Third party SDK violates policy on the developer's behalf
patterns.detection: A bundled SDK requests permissions, tracks users, or behaves in ways the app does not declare. The developer is responsible for SDK behavior.
patterns.fix: Vet every SDK, keep them current, and remove any that collect or share data the app does not declare.

patterns.title: Sensitive tokens or credentials stored in insecure unencrypted formats
patterns.detection: Sensitive session credentials or tokens are saved directly to unencrypted plist, UserDefaults, or SharedPreferences instead of Keychain or Android Keystore / EncryptedSharedPreferences.
patterns.fix: Store all sensitive data and access tokens in iOS Keychain or Android EncryptedSharedPreferences.

patterns.guideline: Apple 3.1.2 subscription terms, US FTC Section 5 / ROSCA, state subscription-cancellation statutes (California, New York, Massachusetts)
patterns.title: Subscription cancellation requires a phone call, mail, or in-person visit while sign-up is a single tap
patterns.detection: A subscription billed outside Apple in-app purchase or Google Play Billing (a web or account-settings cancellation path) directs the person to call, mail, or visit in person to cancel, instead of a self-service in-app or web cancel action. The federal FTC click-to-cancel rule was vacated in 2025 but California, New York, and Massachusetts have their own negative-option statutes in force, and the FTC retains Section 5 and ROSCA authority regardless.
patterns.fix: Provide a self-service cancellation path (in-app button or account-settings web page) that is at least as easy as sign-up. Never require a phone call, a mailed letter, or an in-person visit to cancel a subscription billed outside the app stores' own billing.

patterns.title: Broken support, marketing, or privacy URL in the listing
patterns.detection: A support URL, marketing URL, or privacy policy URL in the listing does not load. Mirrors the fastlane precheck unreachable_urls rule.
patterns.fix: Confirm every listing URL is public and loads during the entire review window.

patterns.title: Unsafe or unvalidated custom deep link URL schemes used for sensitive operations
patterns.detection: Relying on custom URL schemes for sensitive routing, navigation, or passing tokens, without strict input validation.
patterns.fix: Use Universal Links (iOS) and App Links (Android) for secure domain-validated link routing, and sanitize all deep link parameters.

patterns.guideline: Apple Guideline 3.1.2, Directive (EU) 2023/2673 Distance Marketing of Financial Services Directive
patterns.title: Prominent contract withdrawal button or function missing for EU consumer contracts
patterns.detection: Apps offering digital subscriptions or distance contracts to EU consumers that fail to provide a prominent, easily accessible 'withdrawal button' or 'withdrawal function' on their online user interface to cancel/withdraw within 14 days.
patterns.fix: Add a prominent, dedicated, and easily accessible withdrawal button or function on the user interface, allowing consumers to withdraw from contracts/subscriptions without undue friction.

patterns.title: External AI service references in a China storefront
patterns.detection: Manual storefront check. References to ChatGPT, Gemini, OpenAI, or similar external AI services in an app distributed on the China storefront can trigger a regional rejection.
patterns.fix: Remove or localize external AI service references for the China storefront. Source. truongduy2611 china_storefront rule.

patterns.title: Flutter plugin touches required-reason APIs with no PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy
patterns.detection: pubspec.yaml present, a plugin known to touch required-reason APIs (permission_handler, image_picker, geolocator, device_info_plus, package_info_plus, shared_preferences, sqflite, firebase_*) is a dependency, and no PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy exists anywhere in the project.
patterns.fix: Add an app-level PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy and confirm each Flutter plugin ships its own (Flutter 3.19+ plugins mostly do). A missing plugin-level manifest is invisible to Apple unless the app manifest also declares that plugin reason code.

patterns.title: New personal account without the closed test
patterns.detection: Manual check. New personal developer accounts need at least 12 testers for 14 consecutive days of closed testing before production.
patterns.fix: Run the closed test with at least 12 testers over 14 consecutive days, or use an organization account where appropriate.

patterns.title: Data Safety form does not match runtime behavior
patterns.detection: Analytics, ads, or tracking SDKs are present that collect or share data not declared in the Data Safety section. This is the number one Google rejection cause.
patterns.fix: Audit every SDK and runtime data flow and declare every collection, sharing, and security practice accurately in the Data Safety form.

patterns.title: Non compliant ad SDK in a child targeted app
patterns.detection: An app declared for children uses an ad SDK that is not Families certified, or shows behavioral ads to minors.
patterns.fix: Use only Families certified ad SDKs and remove behavioral advertising to minors.

patterns.title: Listing claims a feature the app lacks
patterns.detection: Manual check. The store listing, screenshots, and description must match the app's actual functionality.
patterns.fix: Make the listing match the build exactly, with screenshots of real in app screens.

patterns.title: Missing privacy policy
patterns.detection: No privacy policy URL set in the Play Console store listing while the app collects user data.
patterns.fix: Publish a privacy policy and set its URL in the Play Console store listing.

patterns.title: AccessibilityService used for non accessibility purposes
patterns.detection: BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE declared in an app that is not an accessibility tool.
patterns.fix: Use accessibility APIs only for genuine accessibility features and declare the use, or remove the service.

patterns.title: All files access without a qualifying use case
patterns.detection: MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE declared in AndroidManifest.
patterns.fix: Use scoped storage. Request all files access only for a qualifying use case with the required declaration.

patterns.title: Background location without a qualifying core feature
patterns.detection: ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION declared in AndroidManifest with no clear core feature or prominent disclosure.
patterns.fix: Use foreground location where possible, or justify background use with a core feature and a prominent disclosure and the permission declaration.

patterns.title: SMS or Call Log without an approved core use case
patterns.detection: READ_SMS, SEND_SMS, RECEIVE_SMS, READ_CALL_LOG, or WRITE_CALL_LOG declared without an approved use case.
patterns.fix: Use the permissions declaration form for an approved core use case, or drop the permission.

patterns.title: Misuse of Play Age Signals API
patterns.detection: Usage of the Play Age Signals API (com.google.android.play:age-signals) in conjunction with advertising, marketing, user profiling, or analytics libraries, which violates Google Play's strict Terms of Service.
patterns.fix: Ensure that information from the Play Age Signals API is solely used to provide age-appropriate content and experiences in compliance with laws. Do not use the API or its returned signals for advertising, marketing, user profiling, or analytics.

patterns.title: Digital goods sold without Play Billing
patterns.detection: A web checkout or third party payment SDK is used for in app digital goods rather than Play Billing.
patterns.fix: Use Play Billing for in app digital goods, with regional alternatives only where Google permits.

patterns.title: App does not target the current required API level
patterns.detection: targetSdkVersion in build.gradle is below the current Google Play requirement. From 31 August 2026, new apps and updates must target Android 16, API level 36, or higher.
patterns.fix: Build against the current required Android target API level. From 31 August 2026 that is API 36 or higher. Submissions below the threshold are rejected automatically.

patterns.title: Thin WebView wrapper with insufficient native functionality
patterns.detection: A Capacitor/Cordova/WKWebView marker is present alongside fewer than 2 distinct native-feel plugins (status bar, splash screen, push notifications, haptics, share, camera, local notifications). This is a heuristic proxy for the real Apple 4.2 test (features/content/UI beyond a repackaged website), reviewed manually before treating as a blocker.
patterns.fix: Apple 4.2 Minimum Functionality is the single most common Ionic rejection. Add native Capacitor/Cordova plugins for status bar, splash transition, push, and haptics, or ship as an installable PWA to skip App Review.

patterns.title: Capacitor/Cordova plugin wrapping a native SDK with no PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy
patterns.detection: Capacitor/Cordova plugins are present and no PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy exists anywhere in the project.
patterns.fix: Capacitor plugin manifest support is less standardized than Flutter's. Verify each plugin wrapping a native SDK (camera, geolocation, ads) ships PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy, and add the app-level one.

patterns.title: Deprecated UIWebView symbol statically linked
patterns.detection: The literal UIWebView symbol appears anywhere in the built sources, often pulled in transitively by a stale Capacitor or Cordova plugin.
patterns.fix: Apple auto-rejects (ITMS-90809) any binary statically linking UIWebView. Update every plugin to a WKWebView-based version.

patterns.title: Undisclosed over-the-air JS bundle updater
patterns.detection: package.json depends on react-native or expo, and an OTA updater (react-native-code-push, expo-updates, react-native-ota-hot-update, Stallion) is present with no App Review disclosure of bug-fix-only scope.
patterns.fix: Name the OTA mechanism in App Review notes and restrict it to bug fixes that do not change purpose, UI, or features beyond what was reviewed (Apple 3.3.2, 2.5.2).

patterns.title: React Native native module touches required-reason APIs with no PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy
patterns.detection: package.json depends on react-native or expo, native modules with required-reason API usage are present (Firebase, AsyncStorage, expo-file-system), and no PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy exists.
patterns.fix: Add an app-level PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy. Native modules bundled transitively via JS deps each need their own manifest aggregated in the final IPA.

patterns.title: Setting non-essential cookies without prior cookie consent
patterns.detection: Writing to document.cookie or cookieStore without checking if the user accepted cookies via a cookie consent banner.
patterns.fix: Implement a compliant Cookie Consent banner that blocks non-essential cookies until the user gives explicit consent.

patterns.title: Processing web personal data without GDPR compliance controls
patterns.detection: Collecting or processing personal web data without explicit opt-in controls, privacy policy links, or right to be forgotten (delete) options.
patterns.fix: Integrate standard GDPR compliance gates including explicit opt-in for data processing and a mechanism for data deletion.

patterns.title: Structured personal data stored in IndexedDB without security controls
patterns.detection: Storing user records in IndexedDB without user consent, encryption, or proper deletion lifecycles.
patterns.fix: Use encrypted IndexedDB wrappers for structured sensitive records, check user consent, and clear databases upon logout.

patterns.title: Unencrypted sensitive personal data stored in localStorage
patterns.detection: Storing sensitive details or JWT tokens in plain text in localStorage without encryption or user consent check.
patterns.fix: Avoid storing plain sensitive personal info in localStorage, encrypt any stored tokens, and respect storage preferences.

patterns.title: Sensitive session details stored in sessionStorage without protection
patterns.detection: Storing raw authentication or session keys in sessionStorage without encryption or clean-up logic.
patterns.fix: Limit and secure the data written to sessionStorage, apply encryption, and ensure data is deleted at session end.

patterns.title: Third-party tracking technologies loaded without consent
patterns.detection: Integrating analytic pixels or tracking scripts (Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, Hotjar) without consent validation.
patterns.fix: Load third-party tracking scripts and pixels conditionally only after receiving explicit user cookie consent.

patterns.guideline: US State ASAA (Utah SB 142 / Texas SB 2420 / Louisiana HB 570)
patterns.title: Missing US State App Store Accountability Act age assurance and parental consent controls
patterns.detection: Failing to integrate Declared Age Range API or Play Age Signals API and missing parental consent validation for minor users in applicable US states.
patterns.fix: Integrate native age signal APIs (Declared Age Range on iOS, Play Age Signals API on Android), enforce verifiable parental consent for minor accounts, and purge raw age verification data immediately.

patterns.title: Non-compliance with Amended COPPA Rule requirements
patterns.detection: Collecting childrens data or biometric identifiers without separate opt-in consent for third-party disclosure/targeted ads, or lacking written retention and information security policies.
patterns.fix: Implement separate opt-in consent for third-party sharing/advertising, establish written data retention policies, maintain a written security program, and update verifiable parental consent flows.

patterns.title: Missing AI Literacy Policy and training induction logs for AI system operations
patterns.detection: Operating or deploying AI models or AI features without maintaining an active AI Literacy Policy, team induction records, and training logs.
patterns.fix: Maintain a written AI Literacy Policy, conduct regular AI safety and privacy inductions, and keep an up-to-date AI literacy training log.

patterns.title: Missing AI interaction disclosure or synthetic content marking
patterns.detection: Providing AI chatbots or generating synthetic text/media without immediate AI-interaction disclosures or machine-readable synthetic content watermarks.
patterns.fix: Display immediate in-app disclosures informing users they are interacting with AI, inject machine-readable provenance watermarks (e.g., C2PA) into synthetic media, and disclose artificial manipulation.
